tools_used: Bash (cat, ls, wc, git; python3 -I for reading the JSON files, for writing kinds/I.json via heredoc, and for validating the output against entries/I.json)
sources_read: rules.json (all 73 rules of these entries: name and full description)
notes: No web access was used; no rule description required opening a tool URL.

No entry had a tie between two kinds, so the invariant tie-breaker was not needed.
